name: Act on the Promotion of Research and Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies (AI Act)
summary: Japan's AI promotion framework statute, administered by the Cabinet Office. Per the Cabinet Office page it was promulgated 4 June 2025 and fully enforced 1 September 2025, and it establishes an AI Strategy Headquarters. The Cabinet Office press page states that the AI Basic Plan was adopted by Cabinet decision on 23 December 2025, and a Cabinet Office consultation page identifies the Act as the legal basis of the AI Basic Plan. Cabinet Office pages read via machine translation; statute text not read.
key_obligations: Establishes an AI Strategy Headquarters and a statutory AI Basic Plan

timeline.note: Promulgated; partial enforcement from the same date (Cabinet Office page).
Full enforcement including AI Strategy Headquarters provisions.
First AI Basic Plan adopted by Cabinet decision under the Act (Cabinet Office). The Act's own status is unchanged; this entry records a related plan.
